steps.text: Each player leads a faction: Atreides (+ Fremen Ally) or Harkonnen (+ Corrino Ally)
One player plays a faction alone; two share the other (recommended: share the Harkonnen - House Harkonnen and Corrino Ally)
Both factions shared: House Atreides + Fremen Ally, House Harkonnen + Corrino Ally

Shared Harkonnen: 3-4 player dashboards for House Harkonnen and Corrino Ally replace Giedi Prime; add Emperor Shaddam IV (in play) and Gaius Helen Mohiam figures and Leader cards; 3 Harkonnen Cone of Silence tokens
Shared Atreides: 3-4 player dashboards for House Atreides and Fremen Ally replace Sietch Tabr; 3 Atreides Cone of Silence tokens
steps.note: 3 players: only for the faction that is shared

steps.text: Arrange the two map sections
Shuffle 8 Sietch tokens facedown onto their Areas (only the Atreides may look)
Shuffle the Atreides Garrison Deployment tokens; 1 token and 1 Naib Leader in each Sietch Area
Shuffle the standard Atreides Deployment tokens facedown by the Atreides player
Shuffle 6 Ecological Testing Stations facedown onto their Areas
6 Harkonnen Settlements on their Areas (ratings public)
Shuffle both Harkonnen Garrison Deployment sets; 1 of each type in each Settlement Area, then flip and replace with the figures
Harkonnen: Spice Must Flow board with the 3 Imperium markers on "start here"
3 Prescience markers on 0 and the Supremacy marker on 0
Shuffle the Prescience cards facedown
Shuffle 16 Wormsign tokens into a facedown pool
Take faction dashboards; Named Leaders marked "in play at start" on their Action boxes
Shuffle the 4 Planning decks, each by its back
Atreides draws 1 of the 6 Secret Objective cards (hidden)
Figures, dice and reference cards within reach
Shared factions play cooperatively and win together
Shared faction: each player draws from their own subfaction deck, hand limit 3; discard a Cone of Silence token to confer in secret
Start of round: draw 1 Planning card from each of your decks and reveal 3 Prescience cards; then the Harkonnen place vehicles
